Wake up, everyone. They expect us to swallow this theatrical production about South African actress Terry Pheto being "drawn into controversy." What a convenient script they are running. We are supposed to look away from the real puppet masters while the establishment parades this narrative through Parliament, specifically during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. 

They want us to believe this is just an accidental slip involving R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe. Don't be naive. Every single official investigation and leaked detail is just a carefully staged distraction managed by the hidden elites to control the flow of capital and keep us pointing fingers at the actors while they pull the strings behind the curtain. The official story is always the inversion of the truth.
